_.DitherMatrix: The threshold pattern that decides which cells are inked.
_.DitherBloom: How strong the soft glow around a dither is.
_.DitherGlow: Where a card's light comes from.
_.DitherHover: What a box does when the pointer comes in or it gets keyboard focus.
_.DitherPress: What a box does when it is pressed.
_.DitherIdle: What a box does on its own while on screen.
_.DitherMethod: How a photo is turned into dots: a regular pattern or error diffusion.
_.DitherChartSeries: One series of a chart: its label, colour and values, with optional range and dashing for a line.
_.DitherDonutSlice: One slice of a donut or pie chart.
_.DitherRadarSeries: One series of a radar chart.
_.DitherHeatmapEntry: One day of a calendar heatmap.
_.DitherHeatmapRow: One row of a matrix heatmap.
_.DitherLogoItem: One logo of a logo marquee.
_.DitherPoint: A point in a box, as fractions of its width and height.
_.DitherMarker: A marked place on a globe or map.
_.DitherArc: A route between two places on a globe or map.
